ai_summary: Advait Energy Transitions Limited has secured a significant domestic order valued at over INR 130 Crore (approximately $15.6 million) from Gujarat Energy Transmission Corporation Limited (GETCO) for the reconductoring of 220kV power lines, to be executed within 15 months. This substantial contract aligns with the company's core business, materially impacting its revenue and order book positively. No red flags, such as related-party transactions or unusual terms, are apparent in this standard business development announcement.
